info.name: Insights.Api Balancing Mechanism Dynamic System forecast API
Loss of load probability and de-rated margin forecast (LOLPDRM)

params.name: settlementPeriodFrom
params.description: The "from" settlement period for the filter. This should be an integer from 1-50 inclusive.

params.name: settlementPeriodTo
params.description: The "to" settlement period for the filter. This should be an integer from 1-50 inclusive.

params.name: format
params.description: Response data format. Use json/xml to include metadata.

items.docs:
This endpoint provides the 1h, 2h, 4h, 8h and 12h+ Loss of Load Probability and De-rated Margin forecasts
for each settlement period over a requested time range.
            
For each forecast horizon at 1, 2, 4 or 8 hours, the returned value is the forecast received that number of hours
before the start of the settlement period.
